name: smwpatches-zsnes-detecting-message-boxes
title: ZSNES-detecting Message Boxes
description:
This patch disables message boxes when you're playing the ROM in ZSNES by making of them show a default message instead. Could be handy for people who want to slightly inconvenience ZSNES users but not outright keep them from playing.

The default message can be edited in Lunar Magic's Overworld editor as usual, all you have to specify in the patch is what number it is in the editor.

The default message could say something like
You   seem  to  be
using ZSNES.      

Play   this  in  a
different emulator
to   unlock   this
message.
